dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's the situation?

dialogues.speaker: Lorgar
dialogues.text: It's not looking too good... The hilichurls have been increasingly active recently, it's becoming quite a headache.

dialogues.speaker: Lorgar
dialogues.text: But there's not much I can do beyond warning the adventurers and travelers around here to watch their backs.

dialogues.speaker: Lorgar
dialogues.text: Here are some notes I jotted down, maybe you'll find them helpful. Take care now.

dialogues.speaker: Lorgar
dialogues.text: Hey! Traveler!

dialogues.speaker: Lorgar
dialogues.text: It's dangerous ahead! Don't go that way!

dialogues.speaker: Lorgar
dialogues.text: In front of you is the danger zone... Huh? Could you possibly be...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Lorgar
dialogues.text: The roads ahead are dangerous — a convoy was attacked by powerful monsters in the mountain pass.

dialogues.speaker: Lorgar
dialogues.text: We better leave if we have no business here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Lorgar
dialogues.text: Your attire... Could you be the traveler they spoke of?

dialogues.speaker: Lorgar
dialogues.text: Huh? You don't? Your heroic deeds have already spread across Mondstadt. I heard that it was you who put an end to the storms that terrorized Mondstadt!

dialogues.speaker: Lorgar
dialogues.text: Though I believe you're capable of dealing with the monsters ahead, I'd still like to ask you to watch out and take care.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Lorgar
dialogues.text: Take care.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you seen anyone who looks a lot like me?

dialogues.speaker: Lorgar
dialogues.text: Someone like you? Why, yes, I believe I have...

dialogues.speaker: Lorgar
dialogues.text: A lot of young adventurers like you will come tramping into the Stormbearer Mountains. I turn most of them back, which is good, since it's quite dangerous up ahead...

dialogues.speaker: Lorgar
dialogues.text: Oh— You're looking for a relative, then? I'm sorry, I misunderstood you.

dialogues.speaker: Lorgar
dialogues.text: I don't think the person you're looking for has come to the Stormbearer Mountains. Best you go look somewhere else.
